tool.description: Mandatory recall step: semantically search MEMORY.md, USER.md, Markdown files recursively under memory/ before answering questions about prior work, decisions, dates, people, preferences, or todos. Omit `corpus` to search those configured sources. Session results are transcript search references, not readable memory-file paths. Optional `corpus=wiki` or `corpus=all` also searches registered compiled-wiki supplements; use `corpus=all` only when compiled wiki supplements are needed. `corpus=memory` restricts hits to indexed memory files (excludes session transcript chunks from ranking). `corpus=sessions` searches indexed session transcripts under the same visibility rules as session history tools and returns unavailable when semantic session indexing is disabled. Corpus outcomes cover each requested corpus; only a top-level corpus warning means results are partial and must be surfaced to the user. An optional corpus outcome of not-registered in a multi-corpus result is informational. If response has disabled=true or stale=true, tell the user and include the warning/action guidance.

content.text:
GBrain `0.60.760.0` is ready locally. I verified that the CLI can save and recall a test fact and that the local MCP server exposes its memory tools. Search is keyword-only, no API keys or paid services are configured, and automatic saving and conversation archiving are off.

The only remaining step is connecting OpenClaw. The Gateway is still unreachable from here, so I left its configuration unchanged. No action is needed to use the local CLI.

messages.content: Remember that my sister's new cat is called Griklouskend.

arguments.title: Save the cat’s name as private local GBrain memory and verify it
arguments.command: set -eu; gbrain remember 'The user’s sister’s new cat is called Griklouskend.' --entity user --provenance 'The user stated this directly in the current conversation.' --content-origin user_said --visibility private --json | python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert d.get("state")=="committed" or d.get("status") in ("inserted","duplicate"),d; print("Remember status:",d.get("status"))'; gbrain recall --grep Griklouskend --json | python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert any("Griklouskend" in f.get("fact","") and f.get("visibility")=="private" for f in d.get("facts",[])); print("Verified private memory")'

content.text: Your sister’s new cat is called **Griklouskend**.
